Surface amendment · 2026-11-16T11:58Z
The file surface adds two files:
- `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/fieldWriteGate.ts`: `gateFormFields` is where inline and object fields meet on every layout arm. The stamp moves there, from the two earlier sites in `ObjectForm.tsx` / `sectionFields.ts`.
- `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/lookupRecordReference.ts`: `readRecordBeingEdited` honours only a stamp minted by `withRecordBeingEdited`, through a module-private brand. JSON cannot forge that, so a document-written key never opts a field in, on any host including standalone `type: 'form'`.

Condition: the brand must survive every copy the form pipeline makes of a field def. Pin it through a real `ObjectForm` on the auto layout and on one sectioned layout. If any step deep-clones defs, put the stamp after that step rather than relaxing the brand.

Everything else in claim 6915702451 stands. Branch `claude/project-thread-nn62au`.
